title: Halloween Bedsheet-Ghost Doorway Photo Edit
prompt: Use my photo and keep my face, hair and skin tone exactly as they are. Put me on the edge of a bed in a cluttered early-2000s bedroom at night: posters on the wall, warm fairy lights, a corded phone pressed to my ear. I look a little uneasy. In the dark doorway behind me, slightly out of focus, stands someone under a plain white bedsheet with two eye holes. Make it look like an old point-and-shoot photo with the flash on, a bit of grain and slightly crooked framing. No text or logos.

title: Seedance Product Clip With One Camera Move
prompt: Make a 5-second video of [product] on [surface] in [setting]. Keep the product exactly like my reference image: same shape, colour and label. The camera starts wide and slowly pushes in until the product fills about half the frame, then stops and holds still for the last second. Nothing else moves except [one small detail, like steam rising or light sliding across the table]. Soft morning light from the left. No on-screen text or music, just quiet room sound.

title: Anime Flashlight Mini-Me Photo Edit
prompt: Edit my photo so I'm standing on a quiet street at night, pointing a small flashlight at the ground. Keep me fully photographic and don't change my face. In the circle of light on the pavement, add a tiny anime version of me, same outfit and hair, about knee height, looking up at me surprised. Only the little character is drawn; everything else stays real. Make the beam soft and warm with a little haze around it.
